pool.text: Fredericton successfully withstood a British attack during the early conflicts in the area.
Acadians escaping the British takeover settled the site and named it Pointe Ste-Anne.
The settlement was destroyed during the expulsion of the Acadians from the region.
United Empire Loyalists arrived from New England, marking the beginning of modern history.
The location served as a British garrison town starting in this year until later.
The municipality officially became designated as the shire town of York County.
The New Brunswick Legislative Building was constructed to serve the government.
The municipal police force responsible for local policing was founded.
Christ Church Cathedral was built to serve as the seat of the Anglican Diocese.
The period of operation for the British garrison town concluded in this year.
The city won an innovation award for their Fred-eZone free municipality wide Wi-Fi initiative.
The Intelligent Community Forum selected the municipality as a Top 7 Intelligent Community.
The famous statue Freddy the Nude Dude was taken to Alabama for a replication.
The provincial ridings elected the first-ever MLA for the Green Party of New Brunswick.
DFI received the Downtown Achievement Award of Excellence for a local awareness marketing campaign.
Demographic statistics showed the population breakdown by racial and ethnic categories.
The municipality officially annexed parts of five local service districts on the first day of the year.
